player_prompt.intro:
Yin ee Player {player_id} ({role}) ee game ciɛl de Matching Pennies ee {num_rounds} de round.
- Ee kɔɔr, cɔl [heads] ku [tails] (ku [h], [t]).
- Na cɔl yin ee kɔɔr ee raan yɔ̈ɔ̈k, Player 0 eeŋu kɔɔr; wäärɛɛn Player 1 eeŋu.
Cɔl yin ee kɔɔr ee ciɛl de '[heads]' ku '[tails]'.

message.round_match: Raandit 0 acek {choice0}; Raandit 1 acek {choice1}. Acek ye jam -> Raandit 0 a yeŋ
message.round_mismatch: Raandit 0 acek {choice0}; Raandit 1 acek {choice1}. Acek ye ciɛɛm -> Raandit 1 a yeŋ

outcome.p0_wins: Raan ye 0 ke yen acï wëu juëc bɛ̈n yök.
outcome.p1_wins: Raan ye 1 acï wëu juëc bɛ̈n tiaam.
outcome.draw: Në ye mɛn, ke kɔc acï bɛ̈n mat.
